headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 10-5 win behind Jake Mangum's 4-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Mets took down the Kansas City Royals 7-3, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. The New York Yankees routed the Tampa Bay Rays 12-4, led by Ben Rice's 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with Victor Bericoto being placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins also placed Mick Abel on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other teams affected by injuries include the Athletics, New York Mets, Washington Nationals, Cincinnati Reds, and Philadelphia Phillies.

Several trades and roster movements were announced, including the Minnesota Twins acquiring right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets also acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Pirates in 10-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 10-5 win. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a 4-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st home run of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 2-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome a strong Orioles performance. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs at the plate with 3 hits, including a home run, while Trevor Rogers pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Tommy Nance in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
